name: company-risk-auditor + company-interview-playbook chain
description: Tests that company-risk-auditor provides a risk profile for a company and company-interview-playbook leverages it along with interview intelligence to produce a complete preparation playbook.

input.user_message: 我收到了快手的面试邀请，是电商业务线后端岗位，终面下周。帮我了解一下这家公司现在的状况，以及他们的面试套路。

context.profile_summary: 4年Go后端，有直播和电商平台经验

assertions: company-risk-auditor produces a structured risk assessment covering financial health, layoff history, and employer brand signals
risk assessment distinguishes between verified signals and uncertain areas, with confidence levels per dimension
company-interview-playbook provides the typical interview process stages at Kuaishou for backend engineers
playbook includes at least 3 preparation recommendations specific to the e-commerce business unit context
output acknowledges that interview formats can vary by team and that this is based on available data
must_not_contain: definitive claims about company financial health without citing a source or date
invented internal culture details presented as fact
advice to withdraw from the process based on risk signals without candidate input
